mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, the temperature is 43 degrees under clear skies at Fireman's Park, with a Waning Crescent moon above, an overnight low of 38 degrees, and no rain in the forecast.

City officials have announced that pavement repairs will take place on November 10 and 11, affecting areas like Morningside Boulevard and Mozart Street, with no parking allowed from 7 AM to 7 PM; also, the Plan Commission will meet December 7 to discuss new development projects.
There is a busy weekend ahead, starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market today, live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's today, plus live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
In a report regarding a noteworthy call for service on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I after he was discovered stopped at an intersection for an extended period.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Really Reese's, and since the store is open until 10:30 PM, you have plenty of time to visit before they close for the night.
